sites.title: Curriculum Navigator
sites.audience: Students, faculty, and staff. Open to everyone.
sites.intro: Search the ASCEND curriculum from one place. Find any session, learning objective, or calendar date across all three phases, and see how sessions connect to program objectives, threads, and Areas of Concentration.

views.title: Sessions
views.blurb: Every Phase 1 session by module, with objectives, format, and hours. Built from the master curriculum map.

views.title: Learning objectives
views.blurb: Module objectives and their mapping to the 23 Medical Education Program Objectives.

views.title: Clerkships
views.blurb: The Phase 2 clerkships with their learning objectives.

views.title: Threads and Areas of Concentration
views.blurb: Where each curricular thread and AOC is taught, by session, from the AOC and Threads workbook; rows not yet matched to a session are listed on each AOC page.

views.title: Academic calendar
views.blurb: The current and next academic year, searchable by date or event.

views.title: Directors view
views.blurb: The same content labelled for module and clerkship directors. This is the former Directors’ Dashboard.

views.title: Ask ASCEND
views.blurb: Plain-language questions answered from the curriculum map and policies.

sites.title: Electives and NEXUS Catalog
sites.intro: Explore the career-exploration options offered to ISMMS students: electives, NEXUS Learning offerings, host institutions for away rotations, and what returning students said about them.

views.title: Electives catalog
views.blurb: All medical student electives, filterable by field, Area of Concentration, phase, and schedule. Built from the master electives catalog.

views.title: NEXUS offerings
views.blurb: The NEXUS Learning catalog with the same filters.

views.title: Away electives
views.blurb: Host institutions where students have completed extramural rotations.

views.title: Extramural ratings
views.blurb: Ratings and comments on host institutions from returning students.

sites.title: ASCEND Class Calendar
sites.audience: Office of Curricular Affairs staff, via the ASCEND access code on the Hub.
sites.intro: For planning and review by the Office of Curricular Affairs only; not the schedule of record. The class schedule exactly as it stands in the Office of Curricular Affairs' Google Calendar, refreshed automatically every 30 minutes. Two small calendars for the current and next month sit at the top of every view; open on today's sessions with what is next up, see the week as a Monday-to-Friday board, or list every scheduled session grouped by module, by session type (LEC, SGD, CCSG, LAB, PNL, REV, INT and the assessments) or by week.

views.title: Today
views.blurb: The day at a glance: what is happening now or next, every session as a full card with time and type, and a preview of the next three class days. Opens by default.

views.title: Week
views.blurb: Monday to Friday, each session as a card, plus a strip of all-day items and quiz or pre-check windows that span several days.

views.title: All sessions
views.blurb: Every scheduled session from today onward (or the whole calendar), grouped by module, by session type or by week, with each group collapsible. Combine with the module or type filter to see one module's or one type's full schedule.

views.title: Cohort, module and type filters
views.blurb: Switch between class calendars (Class of 2029 and Class of 2030 in Phase 1, Class of 2027 in Year 4), pick one module, choose session types or assessments from a dropdown, show only mandatory sessions, or search any session by name.

views.title: Contact hours
views.blurb: A button on the calendar that totals the scheduled hours for a module, or for every module, in an academic year: instructional and assessment hours, a table by session type, and a CSV download. A planning estimate from the published calendar.

sites.title: Baby Bates
sites.intro: A pocket clinical reference for history-taking and physical examination, drawn from Bates' Guide, to support clinical skills coaching and direct observation.

views.title: Core physical exam
views.blurb: The core exam and exam clusters by system.

views.title: Scripts and algorithms
views.blurb: Illness scripts, clinical scripts, and diagnostic algorithms.

views.title: Quick reference
views.blurb: Devices, labs, abbreviations, and structural vulnerability resources.

views.title: Practice of Medicine resources
views.blurb: Materials for coaching and direct observation in the POM modules.

sites.title: People
sites.audience: Students, faculty, and staff. Open to everyone.
sites.intro: Who does what across the ASCEND curriculum, in one site: the Office of Curricular Affairs and the faculty roles that are open.

views.title: Office of Curricular Affairs
views.blurb: Org chart and directory of directors, co-directors, coordinators, and managers by phase and area.

views.title: Faculty opportunities
views.blurb: Open roles, leadership positions, and ways to get involved in medical education.

sites.title: ASCEND Phase 1 Directors Dashboard
sites.audience: Module directors, the Pre-Clerkship Curriculum Subcommittee, the Curricular Integration Subcommittee, the EEC, and OCA leadership.
sites.intro: Module-level outcomes for the pre-clerkship phase. Aggregate data by class cohort: how each module's assessments performed, what students said, and how the module maps to the program objectives.

views.title: Module dashboards
views.blurb: One page per module with grading structure, final and component results, NBME customized assessment and end-of-module exam statistics, quizzes, and cohort comparison.

views.title: Student evaluations
views.blurb: Module evaluation results and trends.

views.title: Curricular hours and objective mapping
views.blurb: Hours by format, and module objectives mapped to program objectives.

views.title: Clinical skills
views.blurb: Practice of Medicine and PEAKS I clinical skills by domain, with faculty-group analytics and the competency framework crosswalk.

sites.title: Clinical Skills Portal
sites.audience: Clinical Skills: OCA leadership (ASCEND), the EEC, the Pre-Clerkship and Curricular Integration Subcommittees, Clinical Competency Mentors and RPS. Clinical Skills Rubrics: ASCEND, RPS and CCM only, because it holds standardized-patient checklists, faculty-only rubrics and quiz answer keys. Both sit behind the portal's own server-side gate; your Hub code opens what your role allows.
sites.intro: Two separate dashboards for the Practice of Medicine and PEAKS 1, behind one access code and linked by skill domain: how each class performed in each clinical skill, and the checklists, rubrics and quizzes that produced those scores. Each class runs POM 1 (August) to PEAKS 1 (December of the following year).

views.title: Clinical Skills: Dashboard
views.blurb: Each class's strongest and weakest skill domains across POM 1, 2, 3 and PEAKS 1, with class comparison.

views.title: Clinical Skills: Analytics
views.blurb: Performance by skill, framework, quartile band or faculty group, with sortable heatmaps.

views.title: Clinical Skills: Frameworks
views.blurb: The six skill domains mapped to MEPOs, AAMC competencies, Core EPAs and communication functions.

views.title: Rubrics: Library and items
views.blurb: Every POM checklist, rubric, scoring guide and quiz answer key by class and term, searchable to the single item (ASCEND, RPS, CCM).

views.title: Rubrics: Crosswalk and Compare
views.blurb: One skill across every rubric that scores it, and any two deliveries of a rubric side by side.

views.title: Clerkship monitoring

views.title: Site reports

views.title: Direct observations

views.title: Assessment validity and reliability
views.blurb: Psychometric review of the preceptor evaluation forms, including internal consistency and dimensionality.

views.title: CAMP and Transition to Phase 2

views.title: Objective mapping

sites.title: Meeting Summaries
sites.audience: OCA leadership (ASCEND), governance support staff (SUPPORT) and RPS; colleagues outside the Hub can be given the site's own OCS code. Not for curricular governance minutes: EEC, subcommittee and Monday Curricular Affairs transcripts are turned away, because those minutes are kept in the Governance dashboard.
sites.intro: Turns the transcript Zoom or Teams makes of a meeting into a written summary that someone who missed it can act on. Claude drafts it; you review and edit every line before downloading. Nothing you upload is stored. Your Hub code opens it.

views.title: Upload a transcript
views.blurb: A Zoom “Audio transcript” (.vtt), a Teams transcript (.docx or .vtt), or plain text. The site shows who spoke and for how long.

views.title: Claude drafts the summary
views.blurb: Overview, decisions, action items with owners and due dates, discussion by topic, and open questions. Student names are left out by default.

views.title: Review and edit
views.blurb: Every line is editable on screen. Guessed speaker attributions are flagged for you to check.

views.title: Download or copy
views.blurb: A Word file in the Office of Curricular Affairs layout, or plain text to paste into an email.
